visual_appeal: The NOW PLAYING track is a flat black hole. Make it a 13px meter: fill #1a120c, 1px inset #3a2e22, and a 40% #5c4030 hatch so an empty bar still reads as a bar.
Hero class disc sits at the same value as the panel. Matte it #0e0c0a, pad the icon 10px inside the ring, and add a 2px inner shadow so the purple swirl separates from the green ring.
Too much even gold. Keep the frame at 1px #8a6a32 and reserve #e2c56a for the 1.5 figure and the step discs only.
play_next_clarity: Step 2 'Le Dette: play next' restates the hero kicker. Change to 'Le Dette: spend the banked 1.5' so the step is an action.
'Then Le Bankken, full in 19h' is 11px gray glued to the button. Put it on its own line, 12px #d9cbb3, 6px under the steps: 'Next up: Le Bankken, full in 19h'.
Jacques Hammer is NOT RESTING but still says 'Full in 31d 14h'. A red row must not promise a fill. Copy: 'Not resting · 20% banked · will not fill until he logs out in an inn'.
state_colours: RESTING pills are the same bronze as theme buttons, so orange collapses into chrome. Fill RESTING #8a4b12, text #ffe6c4, border #c47a32. NEARLY FULL #c9a227 / #1a1408. NOT RESTING #9a2b2b / #ffe8e4. FULL #2f6b32 / #e7ffe8.
Left state rails are about 4px. Bump them to 6px and match the bars exactly: full #3dba55, nearly full #f0c43a, resting #e07a1f, not resting #d23b3b.
The amber waste line '#c47a32' sits next to the nearly-full gold. Shift waste text to #e0a060 and keep nearly-full strictly #f0c43a so the fifth hue is only the sentence, not the meter.
character_identity: Race/gender badges are ~14px and unreadable on the hero. Draw them 22px with a 2px #0c0a08 stroke at 4 o'clock.
Color only the class word in the row meta at 90% class color (Mage #69ccf0, Warrior #c69b6d) and leave zone and age in #cbbfa8.
Hero warlock art is a cropped spell texture. Use the standard class silhouette, centered, not edge-bled into the ring.
default_theme: View details, RESTING, and All accounts are one bronze. Primary: fill #a8743a, top edge #f0d7a4, 1px #3a2412, label #fff6e6 13px. Row buttons: fill #3a2c1c, border #6b5434, so they recede.
Alternate rows are nearly the same brown. Use #1c1610 and #2a2218, an 8% luminance step, across the full row including the bar track.
The close cross needs a 22px hit target, 10px glyph #e6d3a4, 1px #6b5434 box, optically centered.
elvui_wc3_fit: Beside the character pane this panel is warm #2a2118 while ElvUI stats are near-black. In ElvUI mode use bg #0e0e0e, border 1px #2a2a2a, and the same sans as the host (12px meta, 14px row names), not Friz-like titles.
Options text is cream on a dead gray top strip. Match host labels at #ffd100, use a 3px #ffd100 nav select, and remove the empty gray bar so it does not read as a broken search field.
Alerts wear Gatewood wood and the main frame is flat. Pick one: an 8px wood corner on the main frame from the same atlas as the toast, or flat ElvUI tooltips for every alert.
alerts_ux: The toast is a third dialog. Cap it at 300x72, drop the gold box, use a 3px #3dba55 left bar, bg #14110e at 92%, 15px cream advice, 12px #c47a32 trigger 4px above, and a 2px dismiss meter on the bottom edge.
Esc card still clones the banner via the red rail and wood frame. Use a 28px ribbon 'ESC MENU' in #1a1208 on #e2c56a, a 16px moon, one 14px line, no red rail, inset 12px from the menu.

Move mode shows a black void in the logout wood and a stray ~14px gray square at center. Cover the void with the toast texture and keep a single 'Drag each one. Esc or Done.' strip instead of repeating drag copy on every card.
readability: Hero meta and row location lines are small gray on brown. Set them to 12px #e4d7c2 on #1a140f. Do not go below 12px for any state or place line.
'No rested XP: kills give normal XP' is faint under the black track. Set it to 13px #f0e2c8, directly under the meter with 4px gap.
Options About line and long checkbox notes are near #7a7058. Raise them to 12px #d9ccb4. RESTING button labels need #ffe6c4, not dark text on bronze.
layout_polish: On the character card the right column under the portrait is empty. Top row: speech left, 96px portrait right, 12px gap. Name, chip, 14px bar, and the two rest lines go full width underneath.
Timeline tick 'Wed 25' does not match 'Wed 2 Dec', and 23:12 collides with the end dot. Use 'Wed 25 Nov' at 11px and add 4px between the dot and the time label.
Bottom bar baselines drift. Snap Unlink, the paired-status line, All accounts, and the checkbox to one 16px grid; paired status at 12px #cbbfa8.
delight: zZZ on the sleeper is a sticker. Draw three glyphs 8px apart in #f2e6c9 at 80%, 50%, and 25% opacity so they float off the ring.
Hero speech needs a tail aimed at the disc, fill #241c14, 1px #6b5434, italic 13px. Give a full bar a 1px outer glow #7dffa2 instead of another chrome color.
Compact subtitle 'best to play first' is limp, and level numbers are state-colored so they fight the status column. Use 'Play this one first' and paint every 'Lv N' in #e4d7c2.

overall_notes: The two-step plan, waste line, and class-in-the-row are real improvements, but the window still reads as a brown spreadsheet with a black hole beside ElvUI. I would not ship it for a demanding user until red rows stop promising a fill time, the ElvUI frame goes near-black and shares one skin with the alerts, and the toast stops looking like a third banner.
